// diagnostic

E0919

`#Inline(Always) fn` body exceeds the guarantee's statement ceiling

What

`#Inline(Always) fn` body exceeds the guarantee's statement ceiling

Why

`#Inline(Always)` guarantees every direct call is inlined on every tier, and copying a large body into every call grows the program. Sema refuses each mark that can't keep the guarantee: a call of itself or a cycle of marked calls (E0917), a use as a value (E0918), a body over the size ceiling (E0919), `#Scrub` (E1016), a read of `context.trace` (E1017) and a foreign body (E1021)

Fix

Reduce the `#Inline(Always)` body below the checked statement ceiling or relax the marker.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0919: tests/ui/inline_always_too_large.stderr.

Error [jet.InlineAlwaysTooLarge]: `big` is too large for `#Inline(Always)`
  --> tests/ui/inline_always_too_large.jet:3:1
    |
  3 | #Inline(Always) big: fn() -> Int {
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Its body has 44 statements, over the 40-statement ceiling that keeps the copy at every call site small. `#Inline(Always)` guarantees that every direct call is inlined on every tier, or the program is refused: sema refuses a function that calls itself or closes a cycle of marked calls (E0917), one used as a value (E0918), one over the size ceiling (E0919), a `#Scrub` routine (E1016), one that reads `context.trace` (E1017) and one with a foreign body (E1021).
 Fix: Drop `#Inline(Always)` (use `#Inline` as a hint the compiler is free to ignore), or split the function so the hot part is small enough to inline.
